domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 在小蠕滑条件下描述轮轨切向力与蠕滑关系的理论。
usage_note: 正文明确其仅适用于小蠕滑，并针对较大蠕滑进行非线性修正。
usage_overview: 常用于车辆—轨道动力分析，建立蠕滑率与轮轨切向力、自旋力矩的线性联系，也可据蠕滑系数构造等效阻尼。其适用范围为小蠕滑；涉及较大蠕滑时，常以线性计算结果为基础引入非线性饱和修正。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Since the Kalker’s linear creep theory is only suited to the cases with small creepages, the nonlinear modification was conducted for the situations of large creepages by the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins model [22].

For the calculation of wheel-rail normal contact forces, the nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory is used to calculate the wheel-rail normal contact force, while the wheel-rail longitudinal and lateral creep forces are obtained based on the Kalker’s linear creep theory.
